label: [ Passoff Reading 151 ]

blocks.text: It is interesting that there are some striking similarities between Roh Moo-hyun and Chavez. The South Korean president`s point of view is considerably similar to the man now celebrating his victory in South America in that they have an apparent commitment to redistribution of wealth and his supporters` anti-Americanism in common. President Roh`s recent survival of an impeachment makes an interesting comparison.
